Name: Calm Colour Valley Recolour
Author: Lavliette
Description:
Calm Colour Valley is a simple terrain recolour mod, it retouches the ground, grass and  cliffs and makes them less harsh compared to the Vanilla Colours.


Things to note:
• No trees are recoloured, so get yourself Simple Foliage, Foliage Redone, Yri's Tree Overhaul or whatever else you like for trees. Whenever the author of Simple Foliage returns, I'll do a unique version for CCV, until then please use GMCM to select different foliage options.
My current suggestions are:
Spring → Starblue
Summer → Earthy
Fall → Wittily
Winter → Whatever floats your boat
[s]

[/s]• You'll be starring at the ugly boulders during the first 5 days of spring near the mine and until summer, the cliff entrance to the bath house will also look ugly. Reason is that I'm too lazy to fix something that's only there temporarily.

• Idk how Ginger Island looks with this, so fair warning about colour mismatches? The important part of the game, uh, I mean the  Main Land should be good though! :D

Compatibilty:
If you want to use this recolour with a mod that uses DNT Tilesheets (for example Reimagined 3), you need to replace the assets in the Vanilla DNT Folder with my edit of them. You'll find this edit in the files down below! These files also just retouch the terrain so... uh, enjoy the bright flowers I guess? (Might fix that in a future update)

Want something more Vibrant? Then check out my other Recolour [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14668]Naturally Valley[/url]!
